description.detailed_description: This is a coronal MRI scan of the head, showing symmetrical brain structures. The image highlights the cerebral hemispheres, basal ganglia, and ventricular system. No obvious abnormalities such as masses, edema, or midline shift are visible. The scan appears to be a T1-weighted image, as suggested by the contrast and tissue differentiation.

description.short_caption: Gram stain of spun CSF showing gram-positive cocci and gram-positive bacilli.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain of spun cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Numerous gram-positive cocci, appearing in pairs and clusters, are visible, along with gram-positive bacilli. The background is orange, consistent with the staining technique. The findings suggest a mixed bacterial population, which could indicate a polymicrobial infection or contamination.
visible_findings: gram-positive cocci in pairs and clusters
orange background typical of Gram stain
